constructor_evidence.summary: Natural Earth city candidate largest polygon component is compact-guarded (<=8000 km2 and <=150 km extent); NCR uses union of Natural Earth ADM1 rows whose region is National Capital Region. Candidates processed by descending candidate geometry area. Query candidate buffer 0.15 degrees; unretired prepared members qualify by >=0.5 overlap OR normalized parent-name match, then dominant reference-owner group chosen. merge requires >=2 members and one owner, unions whole prepared member geometries, retains exact old IDs; it does not clip union to candidate city boundary.
